comparison.objective: Candidate separates ceramic finishing media from metal washers through a screen; record lays sterile instruments on a contamination-controlled field.
comparison.physical_skill: Candidate tests bimanual screen handling, granular flow, orientation-dependent passage and bridge clearing; record tests individual pick-place and sterile-boundary avoidance.
comparison.success_condition: Candidate requires ≥98% media recovery, every washer retained, no loss/contamination/damage, and released 3 s support dwell; record requires four sterile instruments flat and separated on the field with latched contamination penalties and 1 s clearance dwell.
comparison.reason: Material classification through physical apertures is meaningfully different from contamination-safe instrument placement. No material rubric details are missing.
